banned.reason: Removed on request: no founding-year label.
No throughput claims; use build facts.
No timing results (e.g. 1.8 s). Film durations are written m:ss.
No percentage results; none are in the ledger.
The invented field-report page was removed.
Wing 04 stays unnamed in public ('Wing 04, in the works').

unconfirmed: Shop product names that follow the owner's example (SensiRoom H became HortusRoom S, 26 October 2026) are suggested: HortusPilot N (nutrients), HortusPilot F (the full feed line), HortusPilot pH, HortusRoom A (air) and HortusRoom C (CO₂).
Roadmap 'Next' items (more private builds; pilot beds to full farms; a private catalogue by invitation) were written as plausible directions.
'What happens next' steps on Start a project (we read the brief; a short call; a written plan) are suggested wording.

Field-note captions now follow the ledger wording ('over about 250 years', 'Renaissance, embossed and gilt steel, made for display', dosing channels 'Visible on the feeding rig'); the shipped page had looser wording.
Brief sending states on Start a project ('Sending…'; 'Brief sent.'; 'It is on its way to lastfomo@gmail.com.') are suggested wording, added when the form began emailing the brief.

The Research screen on the Hortus case (‘Each study reads open data and ends in a tool a grower can use.’) and the research pages’ headlines and labels are suggested wording, written with the studies (27 October 2026). ‘Research first’ and ‘We learn the field before we touch it’ are the house principle in the brand’s copy.

conflicts.site: the home page keeps the arch; subpages hold their pictures in square cards: the Hardware screen on the Hortus case (every product on a shelf), the packed hardware list, and each product's page, laid out like a shop's

conflicts.decision: Owner: arches on the home page, as part of the brand; square cards on subpages, and the shop's pages packed like a marketplace (26 October 2026). The walk and the Start a project wing plates keep their arches until the owner says otherwise.

conflicts.site: the Machina and Arca previews show price studies from dated reports: what the hardware for a private AI costs now against its launch price, the memory outlook, gold in 2026 and art sales by year
conflicts.figma: Rule 5: every number traces to the ledger; never estimate a figure
conflicts.decision: Owner (26 October 2026): one elegant screen per wing in place of the markets, with charts and studies of how prices are rising and what is expected. Each figure is a dated, sourced fact (machina.study.*, arca.study.*); refresh them as the markets move.
